Lane Carrier Preferences Preferences are enforced automatically during order planning
Lane Origin Destination Mode Preferred Carriers Excluded Carriers Priority Reason Applied To Status Actions
📌 How Lane Preferences Work
When an order is planned on a lane with preferences set:
✓Preferred carriers appear at the top of the rate selection list, highlighted in blue
✗Excluded carriers are hidden from the rate selection list entirely
★Priority level determines which preference wins when multiple rules match a lane
↩Order-level constraints (set on individual orders) always override lane-level preferences
